observations: Desktop charts expose the short braking motion while the surface reference retains the full altitude range.
The locator follows the physical close-view bounds; cropped paths are not shown as new endpoints.
Direction chevrons and elapsed-time dots are visible on the actual plotted paths.
Absolute altitude ranges and signed displacement remain readable outside the SVG.
Whole, concentric contact markers remain centered at the exact event coordinates.
Phone charts and readout cards stack without horizontal overflow, with visible keyboard focus.
Forced colors adapt the palette while solid and dashed paths preserve the case distinction.
Recorded-command provenance remains explicit, and a legacy save shows no invented plot.
